Skipping the bundle is false economy: doing components one at a time means another teardown within 6-12 months when the next plastic part fails.

Preventive option: install AKG Motorsport reinforcement plates BEFORE failure — same $150-300 spend as a reactive repair but no torn metal to deal with.
